decision: 一对双山花、四个中央扁弧上窗和另一对双山花组成的面对长春路八开间；2015年照片中319号牌位于画面自左数第二轴后墙。主件只保留这幅可见街面及檐后的前坡。
scale: Seven intervals of repeating horizontal mortar joints measured in the photographs. An assumed 0.063 m brick course yields a representative bay of 3.3683 local units. Building and yard wall separated by an estimated 6.64 local units.
